## Flagship Projects

- **CrickAuction**: High-throughput real-time IPL bidding simulation engine. Handled 2.4M+ requests during IPL season with sub-millisecond state synchronization and concurrent websocket auction rooms.
- **Portfolio Blueprint**: Tactile engineering portfolio built with Vite, React, Tailwind CSS, custom WebGL liquid glass shaders, and client-side SWR caching.

## Background & Highlights

- **Software Technology Parks of India (STPI)**: Engineering Intern. Developed high-efficiency web interfaces, internal analytics dashboards, and state management optimizations.
- **Hackathon Finalist & Builder**: Built decentralized applications, algorithmic trading proofs-of-concept, and real-time multiplayer applications.
